notes.title: Halloween Update is here!
notes.notes:
[h3]Happy Hauntings, burglars!
A Halloween update is here and features some exciting content![/h3]

[h2]A New Map: The Facility[/h2]
The Facility is a [u]randomly generated[/u] map AND you get to pick its size (small, medium, or large)!

[h2]A Halloween Event[/h2]
Head on over to Riverglen to find the missing pieces to win a prize and explore fun easter eggs!

[h2]New Alarm System[/h2]
Crime is rising and ghosts are starting to take security measures! Some maps now have an alarm system that needs to be disabled. If accidentally triggered, you will have 30 seconds to disarm it before the cops arrive!

[h2]Other Stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] 3 Masks have been added
[*] Gold mask is easier to see
[*] Death screen displays random text
[*] Other minor changes and bug fixes
[/list]

[h3]🎃Happy Halloween!👻[/h3]

notes.title: Overhaul Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello boo-glars![/b]
As we approach spooky season, many quality of life changes and behind-the-scenes reworking needed to be done to pave way for future updates! This update took a lot longer than usual because the entire game needed to be restructured in order to pull it off + some efforts have shifted to a new and exciting project! 
This game will be seeing a lot of exciting updates in the near future, but for now [h2]this update brings you:[/h2]

[h3]Custom Game Mode[/h3]
Not only can you now completely customize your heist (and still get paid!), but you can also play against multiple boo men!

[h3]Nightmare Difficulty[/h3]
Same settings as insane, only now you are going up against 2 random boo men

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*]Regular Changes:
[list]
[*]Random map option
[*]Reworked The Troll to where when he roars, there is a chance it will break the lights
[*]Moved 'Monster Mode' to the regular lobby so players can conveniently swap between modes
[*]Item finder doll is a lot more accurate
[*]Revive doll is a little better too I guess
[*]Players can now equip perks in the lobby
[*]Updated the client's lobby to see the host's selections[/list][/list][list]
[*]PvP:
[list]
[*]Added Cynthia to PvP
[*]Reworked The Troll to reflect changes to the actual Troll + you can now see players in the light when using your roar ability
[*]Boo Men no longer get a hint or notification when players are on the last item[/list][/list][list]
[*]Perks:
[list]
[*]Night Light: You get 3 flares instead of 1
[*]Seeker: Lasts 80 seconds (use to be 30) and get an auditory alert when you are near the item
[*]Lock Picker: Unlocking only takes 8-16 seconds (use to be 16-36)
[*]Goosebumps: Cooldown has been reduced from 12 seconds to 8 seconds.[/list][/list][list]
[*]Bugs + other minor changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed Ghost Girl crashing the game after killing everyone
[*]Reduced Mimic's chase speed
[*]Lobby options save after each round
[*]Minor updates to regular mode difficulty payout and item quantity in multiplayer
[/list][/list]

notes.title: The Cynthia Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Boo![/h1]
Happy [i]whateverdaythisupdatecomesout[/i] day! I am excited to share with you this big and fun update! There is a lot to explore, so here is the breakdown:

[list]
[h3][*]New Boo Man - Cynthia

[*]New Map (Small) - Cubicle Gardens[/h3]

[h3][*]Helper Dolls:[/h3]
Helper dolls will spawn under certain conditions (unless playing on insane) and will aid you in your heist!
[olist]
[*]The Voodoo Doll: When a burglar dies, a voodoo doll containing their soul will spawn somewhere on the map. If a living player interacts with this doll, it will revive that player (one per person).
[*]The Item Finder: This doll will spawn at the start of every heist, but should be saved for desperate times. Interact with this doll and it will -try its best- to lead you to a random, unfound item.
[*]The Breaker Doll: This doll will only appear during power outages (but in the same location each round). If you ever find yourself cornered and far away from the breaker, look for this glowing doll and he will take care of it for you!
[/olist]
[h3][*]Monster Mode:[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Added Ghost Girl
[*]Made the Mimic slightly slower and added a cooldown for turning off the lights
[*]The Scav can hear players through walls
[*]Fixed Edith's ability not always working
[/olist]
[h3][*]Quality of Life + Other:[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Dead burglars can see other dead burglars as spoopy ghosts
[*]Added customization options for shirt color
[*]Light bulbs now actually glow for extra immersion
[*]Revamped tutorial
[*]Minor bug fixes that I will find out are not actually fixed two days from now
[/olist]
[/list]

Remember you can hop on down to the discord posted somewhere on the store page and add feedback as the game keeps evolving!
Thank you and keep stealing from old ladies!

notes.title: Monster Mode Update 3
notes.notes:
[h3]Thank you all for your feedback! This gamemode is still evolving and hopefully this update points it in the right direction![/h3]

[b]In this update...[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Mimic as a playable boo man
[*](Monster Mode only) Buffed all 3 other boo men
-Scav now has a passive 'Sense' ability
-Edith is faster and has a passive 'Stalk' ability
-The Troll will briefly activate all glow sticks when using his roar + charge ability
[*]Garage doors can now be opened (lazily) to allow for an alternate exit to the escape car
[*]Fixed bug where players weren't returning to lobby after each round
[*]Fixed audio replicating to all players instead of only the one playing as a boo man
[*]Made Ghost Girl slower on classic mode
[/list]
[h3]
Thank you all and happy haunts![/h3]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello boo-glars! This update features some quality of life changes/additions:[/b]

[list]
[*]Difficulty overhaul:
-Boo men will start off easy and get harder depending on the number of items collected

[*]Added sound when collecting an item
[*]Added money to Liminal Spaces

[*]Updated prize money for each level
[*]Other bug fixes and minor improvements to AI
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Liminal Spaces
notes.notes:
[b]This content update brings a new map which features a variety of liminal spaces -hence the name!
There might be some tricks in this map to throw you off your burglar game, so be weary of your surroundings! [/b]

This map also comes with two new related masks and some minor gameplay adjustments and bug fixes.


I still might make additions to this map, but I promise the next one will be a size small! The next update I plan on focusing more around quality of life and adding more to the gameplay itself!

[i]Note: If you lost any money or may have corrupted a save in a previous update, please pm me in discord and I will correct it![/i]

notes.title: The Mimic Update
notes.notes:
[b]A new Boo Man was among us all along! 
Introducing... -who you thought was just Tim- ...The Mimic!
The Mimic can disguise as a player to travel through the light, but be weary of anyone running for the switch.[/b]

[h3]In this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Mimic
[*]Added a timer for those who want to speedrun*
[*]Keys now glow in the dark when you are near them
[*]The Troll now only glows when chasing after a player
[*]Fixed ghosts not being able to enter the cabins on Camp Suydam
[/list]

*The timer starts as soon as you drop into the level (swoosh sound effect) and will stop as soon as you touch the escape car!

I know this update took a long time and there are probably going to be some (hopefully only minor) bugs, but I will adjust the Mimic based on player feedback so nothing is currently set in stone! 
For the next update I will continue to fix bugs and possibly add some more stuff to the market, but I will be experimenting with a new fun map that will hopefully add some twists into the game...

You can @ me on discord or pm me because even though I read everything, I am bad at communicating.

-Twisted

Proximity voice chat has been implemented, but is still under development.

This took a lot longer than I was anticipating and I haven't had any luck with some of the features so I will be releasing a (hopefully) working version and extra voice chat features will come down the line in a later update.

Because this took so long, I wanted to get started on the next updates like a week ago. I plan to start implementing perks into the game (pins in the market) and start experimenting with an exciting new boo man!

I will fix Edith being too clingy as well.

Thanks and happy holidays!
